clue.text: Fogeyish old thing keeping smalls in protective covering

explanation.surface: A stuffy old person keeps their underwear wrapped up carefully.

explanation.definitionFit: A fogeyish, hopelessly outdated person is called an old fossil, figuratively.

clue.text: Come again, meeting Queen? He had a tale to tell

definitions.text: He had a tale to tell

parts.note: a request to repeat oneself, the same as saying pardon?
ER, Elizabeth Regina

explanation.surface: Someone asks a storyteller to repeat himself on meeting royalty.
explanation.walkthrough: Chaucer's Canterbury Tales includes the tale told by a pilgrim who sold indulgences.
explanation.definitionFit: Allusion to Chaucer's Canterbury Tales, in which this pilgrim tells one of the stories.

clue.text: Spanish woman within borders of Gabon

explanation.definitionFit: Galicia is a region of north-west Spain, so its things and people are Spanish.

clue.text: In Govan it yields self-love

clue.text: Old-fashioned type picked up here in ancient Rome

hic is the Latin word for here

explanation.surface: An antiquated font was collected here in classical Rome.

explanation.definitionFit: Gothic or black-letter is an old-fashioned typeface, the font of medieval manuscripts.

clue.text: Class of animal I once observed by railway

parts.note: a cat is an animal
ego is Latin, an old language, for I

explanation.surface: Someone describes the kind of beast they once watched beside a railway line.
explanation.definitionFit: A category is a class or grouping, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Attic literary work?

John Braine's 1957 novel of that title

Hamlet is Shakespeare's play

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the word birds

explanation.surface: A man chasing women turns up after a show somewhere in London.

clue.text: National flag staff sited outside hospital?

parts.note: a flag is an iris, the plant

explanation.definitionFit: A national is a citizen of a country; one from Ireland is an example.

clue.text: Not concerned to phone briefly, ringing America from the east

clue.text: Attractive lady initially replacing daughter in play

parts.note: a comedy is a type of play

indicators.note: initially points to the first letter of lady

explanation.definitionFit: Comely means pleasant to look at, a slightly old-fashioned synonym.

clue.text: Sound old Egyptian ruler and calm Atlantic islanders

explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound' looks like an adjective meaning healthy, but it signals a homophone.
explanation.definitionFit: The Faeroese are the people of the Faeroe Islands in the North Atlantic.

clue.text: Corn possibly restricting British intellectual

indicators.note: the outer word restricts, or hems in, the abbreviation

parts.note: corn is an example of cereal, hence possibly

explanation.definitionFit: Cerebral means of the intellect, a synonym for intellectual.

clue.text: Why, say, knight plunged into river over there?

explanation.definitionFit: Yonder is an archaic adverb for over there, at a distance.

clue.text: Eg Cicero's old flair finally coming to a peak

indicators.note: finally points to the last letter of flair

parts.note: a tor is a rocky peak

explanation.surface: The Roman statesman's talent eventually reaches its height.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's is short for 'is', linking the definition to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Cicero was a famous Roman public speaker, an example of a great rhetorician.

clue.text: Strike poles around this place, producing fragments

parts.note: to smite is to strike
here means this place
N and S are the north and south poles

explanation.surface: Hitting posts in this spot smashes them to bits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'poles' looks like posts to hit, but means the compass points; 'around' wraps the strike word round this place, with the poles tacked on after.
explanation.definitionFit: Smithereens are small broken pieces, as in smashed to smithereens.

clue.text: Look: wearing clergy's garment!

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look
in means wearing, as in dressed in
the cloth is a collective term for the clergy

explanation.surface: Someone exclaims at what a priest has on.
explanation.definitionFit: A loincloth is a simple piece of clothing wrapped round the hips.

clue.text: Universal remedy, one in country mother abandoned

indicators.note: the one goes in the shortened country
the country has abandoned, or lost, a letter

parts.note: Panama is a Central American country
ma is a familiar word for mother
an ace is a one in cards

explanation.walkthrough: 'abandoned' drops the familiar word for mother from the Central American country, and 'in' sets the card one inside what remains.
explanation.definitionFit: A panacea is a supposed cure for all ills, a synonym for universal remedy.

clue.text: Bolt, showing resistance over current surgeon

clue.text: Admit being personal

explanation.definitionFit: To own up is to admit; and something your own is personal to you.

clue.text: Divorcee and teen regularly taking port right outside

parts.note: Rio de Janeiro is a Brazilian port

explanation.surface: A divorced person and a teenager often go to a port on the right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes the first and third letters of TEEN, T and E.
explanation.definitionFit: Exterior means the outside surface, a synonym.

clue.text: Parson goes mad about opening of yucky snack bar

mad signals the letters going crazy into a new order
the opening of a word is its first letter

explanation.walkthrough: PARSONGOES rearranged ('mad') goes 'about' Y, the opening of yucky.

clue.text: Pedagogue with yen to limit Republican disloyalty

parts.note: a pedagogue is a teacher

explanation.definitionFit: Mindful means attentive and heedful, an adjective matching taking heed.

clue.text: Council leader runs one of 20's counties first

explanation.walkthrough: Mayo is a county in the west of Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: A mayor is the elected head of a town or city council.

clue.text: Wool producer the present solver talked of

parts.note: the person solving this clue is you
